notes: Items name the Act and section that govern the question. Each is verified against that section's text by scripts/build_golden_set_v4.py.
A passage that merely mentions a provision does not count. Repealed-code equivalents do not count, since the question is what the law is.
Written from the statutes, not from retrieval output. Do not edit an item to suit a result.

27 Nov 2026: grounds added to 20 more items (10 police, 6 citizen, 4 advocate), each written from the governing section's text in the corpus, not from any answer. Coverage is now measured on 30 items, so it is not comparable with the earlier 10-item figure.
